name: CV Competency Reviewer
install: python3 -m pip install --upgrade 'pip>=24.2' && python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && export LLM_PROVIDER=none && python3 -m uvicorn cv_reviewer.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
